title: New York sues Polymarket, alleging it is running an illegal gambling operation
summary: The state wants to block Polymarket from operating without a gambling license and recover allegedly illegal gains.

title: U.S. Federal Reserve moves on proposals to implement GENIUS Act for stablecoins
summary: The Fed proposed rules on putting last year's GENIUS Act into place with regulations, including those governing stablecoin yield programs.

title: Crypto exchange Bitget says $352 million affected in a hack, claims user funds are 'safe'
summary: Bitget CEO Gracy Chen announced the hack shortly after independent researchers flagged unusual wallet movements.

title: Someone was trying to sell Ondo Finance after founder Nathan Allman's death
summary: The company has vehemently denied that it was shopping for buyers. Allman’s estate declined to comment.

title: Bullish, Alpaca and Apex Fintech form coalition to push issuer-backed tokenized stocks
summary: The group aims to link onchain shares to official shareholder records following the U.S. SEC's innovation exemption for tokenized stock trading.
